name: Asta

ASTA_TOKEN.description: Optional Asta API token for the asta CLI and skills; leave blank and run `asta auth login` instead.

postCreateCommand: if command -v skills >/dev/null 2>&1; then skills add /opt/asta-plugins --all -g --yes; else npx --yes skills@1.5.0 add /opt/asta-plugins --all -g --yes; fi
